Please provide the below details for the request to be processed

### Team contact (Email Address)
The person in the team who acts as a contact for the WCA team


### Use Case for WCA Chat API
2-3 sentences how you plan to use the WCA API



### Confirmation

By entering `I confirm`, the team contact confirms that:
- We will not share the API key with anyone outside the team.
- We will safeguard the API key, and not store it in Github or other places.
- We will use the API key for an IBM-internal use case. We will not use it in an IBM product, or when working with customers
